SwitchUnreachable: The address before was no longer reachable.

AddAddressSubtitle: Another way to reach the same server for {account}
AddressInvalid: Enter an address such as cloud.example.com.
AddressChecking: Looking at the address. Nothing of your sign-in is sent.
ApproveBody: It answered over a secure connection. Nothing of your sign-in has been sent to it yet.
ApproveInsecure: Its certificate is not valid, so this address cannot be used.
ServerSameVersion: Nextcloud, same version as your main address
ServerOtherVersion: Nextcloud, another version than your main address
ApproveCheck: I set up this address myself. Nextcloud MyGo may send my sign-in for {account} to it.
VerifyTitle: Step 3 · Check it is the same server
VerifyBody: After approval, Nextcloud MyGo signs in there and compares your account and your folders with the main address. The address is used only if everything matches.
SetupWelcomeBody: Keep your files in sync with your Nextcloud, at home, at work or on the road, through whichever address of your server works best right now.
ServerAddressHint: The address you open your Nextcloud with in a browser. You can add home or VPN addresses later.
SignInNote: You sign in on your server's own page in your browser. Nextcloud MyGo never sees your password.
SetupSignInBody: Your browser opened {server}. Sign in there and choose Grant access for Nextcloud MyGo, then come back here.
WaitingBrowser: Waiting for you to finish in the browser…
SignInFoot: The sign-in link stays valid for 20 minutes. Your server gives Nextcloud MyGo its own app password, kept in Windows' credential store; you can revoke it on the server at any time.
SignInFailed: Signing in did not finish. Try again.
SetupFoldersBody: Each folder on the server gets a folder on this PC. Changes on either side reach the other.
NoServerFolders: The server has no folders yet. Make one there, then refresh.
SetupStartBody: {count, plural, one {# folder} other {# folders}} from {account} will sync with this PC. A few choices before starting:
StartAtSignIn: Start when I sign in to Windows
StartAtSignInHint: Opens in the tray, without a window, so your files keep syncing.
NotifyMe: Tell me when something needs me
NotifyMeHint: Deletions to review, signing in again, files changed in both places.
OtherAddressTitle: Reach your server another way at home or over VPN?
OtherAddressBody: Optional. Add its other addresses; each one is approved and verified before it is used.
GeneralAbout: How Nextcloud MyGo looks, starts and closes.
LanguageHint: Used everywhere in the app and its notifications.
AppearanceHint: Light, dark, or the same as Windows.
OpenAtSignInHint: Starts syncing as soon as you sign in to Windows.
StartInTrayHint: When opened at sign-in, show no window, only the tray icon.
CloseButtonHint: Either way your files keep syncing. To stop, use Quit and stop syncing in the tray.
AddAnotherAccountHint: Runs the setup again for another Nextcloud account.
NotificationsAbout: Which events show a Windows notification.
NotifyDecisionsHint: Many files deleted at once wait for you before the server deletes them.
NotifySignInHint: An account's server stopped accepting its app password.
NotifyConflictsHint: Both versions are kept; you choose which to keep.
NotifyUpdatesHint: A new version of Nextcloud MyGo is ready to install.
SyncAbout: How folders sync, for every account.
PauseEverythingHint: Nothing uploads or downloads until you resume. Folders you paused on their own stay paused.
DeletionProtectionHint: When many files are deleted at once, sync waits for you before deleting them on the server.
NetworkSettingsAbout: How each account reaches its server.
NetworkSettingsRow: Addresses and how they are chosen
NetworkSettingsHint: Each account has its own addresses, approved and verified one by one.
AboutAbout: The version you run, where its source lives, and how it updates.
UpdateAvailableHint: Signed and checked. It installs once sync reaches a safe point.
UpdateWaits: The update waits until sync reaches a safe point: files are moving or an address is changing. It is tried again later.
UpdateFailed: The update could not be installed. This version keeps running.
UpToDateApp: Nextcloud MyGo is up to date.
UpdatesOff: This build cannot update itself: it is not a signed release.
AutoInstallHint: Never while files are moving, a deletion waits for you, or the address is switching.
LicenseHint: GPL-3.0. Built on the Nextcloud Desktop sync engine and MyGo.
DiagnosticsAbout: What helps when something goes wrong.
SupportBundleHint: A file with the sync service's sanitized state (versions, states, counters) to share when asking for help. No passwords, file names or contents; never uploaded.
FirstClose: Nextcloud MyGo keeps syncing in the tray.
ToastStale: The list changed. Review it again.
ToastFailed: That did not work. Try again.
ActionAllowDeletions: Allow {count, plural, one {# deletion} other {# deletions}}
AutoUnavailable: Automatic choice of the address is not available in this build yet: each account uses the one address you choose.
ConfirmRemoveAddressBody: Nextcloud MyGo stops using this address and forgets your permission to send your sign-in there. Your files are not affected.
DaemonConnectingHint: The background sync service starts by itself. Your files are not shown until it answers; that does not mean they are gone.
DetailFinished: Every folder finished its last sync. File sync in this build is still being verified: keep your own copy of important files.
DetailOffline: The server cannot be reached now. Nothing is lost: sync goes on when it answers again.
DetailUnknown: Not connected to the background sync service, so its state is not known.
DisconnectedBanner: Not connected to the background sync service. This is the last known state; nothing here is current.
NoAddressInUse: No address can be used right now.
ReasonAuthRequired: The server no longer accepts this app's password. Sign in again.
ReasonBusy: Sync is finishing something first. Try again in a moment.
ReasonCredentialsLocked: Windows could not unlock the saved sign-in. Sign in to Windows again, then try again.
ReasonDeletions: Many deletions wait for your review.
ReasonDiscovery: Not every file could be checked. Nothing is deleted until a full check succeeds.
ReasonFolderMode: This folder cannot be synced, for example because it is end-to-end encrypted.
ReasonFolderOwned: This folder, or one inside or around it, already syncs.
ReasonAccountExists: This account is already added: the same user on the same server.
ReasonQuota: Your storage on the server is full: new and changed files are not uploaded until you free some space there.
ReasonIdentity: This address answers as a different server. Your sign-in is never sent there.
ReasonInterrupted: The background sync service restarted before this finished. Try again.
ReasonJournal: The folder's sync record cannot be read. Nothing is deleted; Diagnostics has details.
ReasonLocalRoot: The folder on this PC cannot be found or opened.
ReasonLocked: A file is locked on the server. Sync tries again later.
ReasonLoginExpired: The sign-in link expired. Start again.
ReasonNetwork: The server cannot be reached now.
ReasonPermission: The server does not allow this change.
ReasonRemoteRoot: The folder on the server cannot be found or opened.
ReasonRootChanged: The folder was replaced or moved. Nothing syncs until it is checked.
ReasonSentenceVerified: it was verified as your server.
ReasonServerResponse: The server answered in a way that was not understood.
ReasonStateUnavailable: The background sync service cannot read its state right now.
ReasonSyncFailed: The last sync did not finish. It is tried again by itself.
ReasonThrottled: The server asked to slow down. Sync goes on by itself later.
ReasonTLS: The server's certificate could not be verified. Nothing is sent there.
ReasonUnsupported: This build cannot do that yet.
ReviewExpires: Allowed by {time}, the sync goes ahead; after that, the folder is checked again first.
ReviewKeep: To keep the files, put them back where they were and choose Decide later: the next check finds them again.
ReviewWouldDeletePC: {count, plural, one {# file deleted on the server would be deleted here} other {# files deleted on the server would be deleted here}}
ReviewWouldDeleteServer: {count, plural, one {# file deleted here would be deleted on the server} other {# files deleted here would be deleted on the server}}
StartupBackoff: It waits before it tries to start again.
StartupDatabase: It cannot open its own database.
StartupDiagnostic: It started in a diagnostic mode.
StateUnavailableBody: Your accounts and folders are not shown until it can read them again. Diagnostics has details.
StateUnavailableTitle: The background sync service runs without its state
StopFailed: Background sync did not stop; it keeps running.
SyncPreview: File sync in this build is still being verified and is not yet supported for everyday use. Keep your own copy of important files.
SyncServiceHint: Its version, how it started, and for each folder its transfers and counters, as it reports them.
ToastAllowed: Allowed. The folder syncs the deletions now.
ToastNoAnswer: The background sync service did not answer in time. What you asked may still happen.
ToastNotConnected: Not connected to the background sync service. Try again in a moment.
ToastRefused: That is not possible right now.
WhyMain: Your server's main address, verified when you signed in
AccountNeedsSignIn: Sign in again on this PC: its folders wait until you do
AttnNeedsSignInBody: The saved sign-in cannot be used on this PC, or a renewal waits for your browser. Its folders wait; your files are safe.
AttnQuotaBody: Syncing still finishes, but new and changed files are not uploaded until you free some space on the server. Downloads go on.
ModeFullHint: Every file is downloaded and stays available offline.
ModeOnDemandHint: Files show in Explorer and download when you open them. Chosen once for each folder.
BlockedTLS: Blocked: its certificate could not be verified. Your sign-in is never sent there.
BlockedUntrusted: Blocked: you have not allowed this address. Your sign-in is never sent there.
BlockedSignIn: Not used until you sign in again.
WhyFasterPlain: Answers faster than the main address
WhyFasterMs: Answers in {ms} ms; the main address in {main} ms
WhyJoined: You joined the network this address belongs to
WhyUnreachable: The other addresses do not answer now
WhyPostponed: The last switch waited for a transfer to finish
SidebarMoreAccounts: {count, plural, one {# more account} other {# more accounts}}
OneAccountOnly: This version of the sync service supports one account.
UpdateWaitsDeletion: The update waits until you review the deletion waiting in Activity.
FolderQuotaDetail: New and changed files are not uploaded.
